# QYL0501: Metric method must be partial

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |
| Category | `Metrics` |
| Code fix | Yes |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0501MetricMethodMustBePartialAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Methods decorated with [Counter] or [Histogram] attributes must be declared as 'partial' to allow the source generator to implement the metric recording logic. The generator creates the method body that records values to the corresponding instrument.
